canonicalAdoptionConsumers.current: Advance one H/X position for every Hull point lost.
canonicalAdoptionConsumers.x2Equivalent: Advance one legacy H/X position per two new-scale Hull points lost, with deterministic remainder/carry semantics across packets.
canonicalAdoptionConsumers.why: Otherwise doubling Hull and damage would also double internal-critical frequency.

canonicalAdoptionConsumers.current: A successful queued Hull repair restores 1 Hull.
canonicalAdoptionConsumers.x2Equivalent: Restore 2 new-scale Hull points for the same legacy repair effect; a future intentionally smaller repair could use 1 point as a new half-step.
canonicalAdoptionConsumers.why: Repair magnitude is in the Hull point domain.

canonicalAdoptionConsumers.x2Equivalent: Preserve the old-domain rounded result then scale it, or explicitly redefine degradation as exact 50% in the new domain.
canonicalAdoptionConsumers.why: For odd legacy damage values, naive x2 followed by HalfRoundedUp is not mathematically equivalent (e.g. old 3 -> 2; new 6 -> 3 instead of equivalent 4).

canonicalAdoptionConsumers.current: Player-facing precision text includes +1 shield-only damage or +1 penetration effects in relevant layer cases.
canonicalAdoptionConsumers.x2Equivalent: A legacy +1 magnitude becomes +2 new-scale points if exact equivalence is intended; a new +1 would intentionally be a half-step.
canonicalAdoptionConsumers.why: Natural-100 effect magnitudes are point-domain modifiers even though the current CP121 research consumer does not simulate internal precision criticals.

canonicalAdoptionConsumers.source: technology_component_table / auxiliary catalogs / numerical matrix branch candidates
canonicalAdoptionConsumers.current: Examples include Shield Armor and Ablative/Armor Integrity magnitude bonuses.
canonicalAdoptionConsumers.x2Equivalent: Scale point-domain bonuses by 2 while retaining TP, Space, percentages, and counts.
canonicalAdoptionConsumers.why: Optional components must remain equivalent to the base point scale.

canonicalAdoptionConsumers.current: Several historical calibration simulators contain literal Shield recharge or legacy point-profile values.
canonicalAdoptionConsumers.x2Equivalent: Either freeze/archive those consumers or convert their point constants and add equivalence fixtures.
canonicalAdoptionConsumers.why: A canonical scale conversion must not leave active regression consumers on mixed units.

cp121Boundary.hardGate: All 4,284 CP120 variants must be exact outcome/telemetry equivalents under same-seed paired legacy versus x2 execution before odd half-steps are interpreted.
